test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The selling price of an article is (7)/(6) times the cost price. What is the loss/gain percentage (correct up to two decimal places)?
solution:
**Given:**

SP = (7/6)CP

**Concept used:**

Profit = [(SP - CP)/CP] × 100

**Calculation:**

Profit = [((7/6)CP - CP)/CP] × 100

⇒ Profit = (1/6) × 100

**∴ Profit is 16.67%**
